evidence.excerpt: full_name: hakoniwalab/hakoniwa-robot-runtime; description: A runtime framework for actuator-type robots built on Hakoniwa. Hakoniwa-robot-runtime assembles reusable MuJoCo-based parts (from hakoniwa-mujoco-robots), joints, sensors, and actuators, into a unified execution layer, exposing a consistent Hakoniwa PDU interface for ROS 2 control across wheeled, arm, and legged robots.
